security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU TCG translates a vector floating-point instruction without checking the altfmt bit in vtype, causing instructions that should be RESERVED (illegal) under altfmt=1 to execute with FP16 semantics instead of raising an illegal instruction exception, or conversely, instructions that should use BF16 format under altfmt=1 to execute with FP16/FP32 semantics
security_spec.vulnerability_pattern: translator checks SEW but does not inspect vtype[8] (altfmt) before dispatching to gen_helper_* for vector float ops; or gen_vsetvl does not set vill when (altfmt && SEW >= 32) or when (altfmt && SEW == 8/16 && op is reserved); or NaN-boxing in †† instructions uses FP16 canonical NaN instead of BF16 canonical NaN when altfmt=1
security_spec.summary: Zvfbfa adds altfmt bit (vtype[8]) that fundamentally reprograms vector FP instruction semantics to BF16 and renders most FP ops RESERVED in altfmt=1 mode; QEMU TCG must check altfmt on every vector FP translate path and set vill for reserved combos, or guest code executing BF16-tagged instructions escapes the spec-enforced instruction set restriction
